items.title: Prediction market traders think job creation rebounded in August

items.title: Buffett remains active at 96, but Berkshire's shares aren't doing much

items.title: U.S. appeals court rules against prediction markets, sets up likely fight at Supreme Court
items.summary: The 9th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that sports-related event contracts are not swaps, contradicting a 3rd Circuit ruling from April.
